textSnippet: DONNELLY: Death : Irish Times The Irish Times My Account --> Subscribe Sign In --> Family Notices Irish Times Family Notices Recent Notices Book a notice Sign in DONNELLY: Death Death 327 --> Published in the Irish Times on 4th February 2008 DONNELLY (Sycamores, Kilkenny and late of Corbally, Limerick, England, U.S.A., Hong Kong and Thailand) - February 2, 2008 in Aut Even Hospital, Kilkenny, Tomás Francis (Mossy/Tom) (B.L.), beloved youngest son of the late John and Kathleen; he will be sadly missed by his brothers, Br. Morgan (C.F.C., Dublin), Fr. Seán U.S.A., sisters Moira (Leonard, Dublin), sister Ita (Scott, Kilkenny), nephews, nieces, grandnephews, grandnieces, relatives and friends worldwide. Rest in peace. Funeral prayers this (Monday) evening at 6.30 o'clock in Hehir's Funeral Home, followed by removal to St. Canice's Church. Funeral on Wednesday after 11 o'clock Mass to Newlands Cross Crematorium."Ar dheis Dé go raibh a anam dilís." Jeggo. David : Obituary... Jeggo.
